items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see.

ctx.x: He never played with us because he left and went away, he went to Texas you see. He left and went to Texas. But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see. So well after that all left, well quite naturally that just left me. So now. I said well, I said it's my move now you know. So what I did Mr. Bill, I met up my mind and left. That's why I came here. I was down here living on Clio Street when this boy River, Elton, when he written on the…

items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: I got the other brother, Clarence Hall, he played with me. He played the banjo with us.

ctx.x: And you did name it that then?

Niles Band. So after that, well, we bring it, we bring it real good, you see? So we've been going all over and playing, you know what I mean? Playing all around, you see? So Edmund, he left. My cousin, Nile Thomas, he left and went to Baton Rouge. And so I got the other brother, Clarence Hall, he played with me. He played the banjo with us. So he left. So I was the last one to leave. You see, to come here, you see? Yeah. So, well, finally, well, I was the last one. So after they all left, I played with the band…
Mr. Thomas, wait a minute. I want to take you back a little bit. You said you were 15 when you started playing the trumpet.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Clarence left. That left me. I'm the only, last one.

ctx.x: But you had to have a teacher sometime to know as much as you know.

No, we ain't had no, I'm gonna tell you, I'm gonna come, I'm gonna come to that. Okay. See? Well, we went on. We went on like that for a long time. So when Edmund, Robert, he left. All right. Edmund, my cousin, you see, they had another drummer with my cousin, 9L Thomas, you see? Well, he, he, he was playing drums, he was a small kid, he was playing in, in one of the musical bands, all, all musicals, you see? Well, he used to have a teacher to come out there and teach them fellas, you see? Yeah. So when he, when…
I didn't know him, but he was-
